All youth 18 and under register and race the 18-mile and 36-mile races for FREE! ~ Sponsored by Grand Rapids Chair Co. We also offer a Youth Team Competition sponsored by Grand Rapids Chair Co. . CLICK HERE for more details.The Barry-Roubaix proudly participates in the Michigan Gravel Race SeriesPhotography courtesy of ROB MEENDERING PHOTOGRAPHY , ANDY CLEARY , and CLARE PANICCIA PHOTOS RESULTS
